# MDL508 · `masquerade-file-missing`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A `<file X>` of a masking format does not exist.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | — |
| Flags | opt-in |
| Design references | F11 |

## Why

`random_format` reads `<file X>` when mydumper loads its table sections: a missing file aborts mydumper at startup ("File not open"). Relative paths are resolved against mydumper's working directory, which mydumper-lint cannot know: pass it with `--base-dir`. Opt-in, because the files usually exist only on the backup host.

## Example

With mydumper v1.0.5-1:

❌ Before:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
`first`=random_format <file names.txt>
`last`=random_format <file surnames.txt>
```

```text
3:22-3:41 warning MDL508[masquerade-file-missing] the file `surnames.txt` does not exist (resolved as testdata/files/surnames.txt)
  = mydumper aborts at startup: "File not open".
```

## Configuration

Opt-in: enable it with `--extend-select MDL508`, or in `.mydumper-lint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  extend-select: [MDL508]
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL508` on the line above it.
